persona.name: Karim Haddad

occupation.title: Backend Developer
occupation.organization: A payments fintech scale-up in the Part-Dieu business district, Lyon
occupation.description: Builds and maintains payment-routing services in Go; two release trains a week and an on-call rotation he mildly resents. Works hybrid — three days at the office, two from the apartment he shares with his girlfriend in Villeurbanne. Evenings often disappear into code reviews or climbing sessions.

persona.education: Engineering degree from INSA Lyon; self-taught in half the technologies he actually uses, and proud of it.
long_term_goals: Make tech lead without becoming a meetings person
Learn to cook the Lebanese dishes his grandmother never wrote down
Buy an apartment with Sonia before Lyon prices make it a joke
persona.style: Fast, enthusiastic talker who thinks out loud and edits himself mid-sentence. Loves trying new apps and services and gives them detailed, opinionated reviews to anyone nearby. Wears the Lyon tech uniform — sneakers, hoodie, one nice jacket for client days — and gestures a lot when describing food. His default mode is 'sure, let's test it, worst case we cancel.'

interests: Testing food delivery and grocery apps
likes: Spicy food his girlfriend won't share
APIs and menus with sensible defaults
The bouchons his team goes to on Fridays
dislikes: Carrying groceries up four floors without an elevator
Deciding what to eat at 20h with an empty fridge
Food waste guilt when veggies liquefy in the crisper
Cooking the same three pasta dishes on repeat

beliefs: Most life admin can and should be automated
Trying something new is cheaper than wondering about it
Food is how his family shows love, and he's behind on the skill
Good tools pay for themselves in mood
skills: Finding promo codes in under a minute

general: Orders Uber Eats twice a week and feels vaguely bad about it
Starts free trials without hesitation, actually cancels most of them
Sends Sonia screenshots of things they should 'definitely try'
Grocery shops chaotically at the Casino downstairs at 20h45

morning: 8h15 wake-up, shower, oat-milk flat white from the machine he over-researched
Standup at 9h30, from home in a hoodie or at the office in the same hoodie
workday: Lunch: office days a poke bowl, home days whatever exists, sometimes nothing until 15h
evening: Other nights: code, series, or dinner improvisation that ends in pasta
weekend: Saturday morning climb, afternoon errands he half-finishes
Sunday lunch at his parents' in Venissieux — his mother sends him home with containers

health.physical: Fit from climbing; finger tendon issue he ignores against advice. Eats erratically on weekdays.
health.mental: Upbeat and resilient; on-call weeks make him scratchy.

relationships.name: Sonia Mansouri
relationships.description: A speech therapist with regular hours who's tired of being the default meal planner; she's the one who said 'either we get organized or we get a service.'

relationships.name: Nadia Haddad
relationships.description: Feeds him every Sunday and audibly doubts any dinner that arrives in a cardboard box.

relationships.name: Theo
relationships.description: Already subscribed to a meal kit; their belay conversations are 50% route beta, 50% recipe reviews.
